capability.summary: Read current CoinGecko crypto prices in chosen fiat currencies
capability.description: Calls CoinGecko's fixed simple/price endpoint for one comma-separated coin-id list and an optional quote-currency list defaulting to usd. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: Current cryptocurrency spot-price lookup; not investment advice, historical pricing, exchange execution, or portfolio valuation.

constraint.io_signature: Input: required coin ids and optional vs_currencies (default usd); output: JSON envelope containing http_status and CoinGecko price mapping or HTTP error body. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: optional comma-separated vs_currencies; wrapper default is usd
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: fixed GET https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/price with ids=<ids> and optional vs_currencies=<currencies>, default usd; no market, history, or exchange filters
HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
wrapper does not normalize or truncate results; current prices are time-sensitive and API rate limits may apply
no auth header, local cache, or retry; external network required and shared timeout is 25 seconds

input_contract.name: vs_currencies
input_contract.description: Optional comma-separated quote currencies; wrapper defaults to usd.

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing CoinGecko's current coin-to-currency price mapping or HTTP error body, requested URL, and HTTP status; HTTP 400-599 responses and request exceptions produce error envelopes.

intent_tags: convert coin ids to fiat quote prices
negative_intents: place a crypto trade or transfer
provide investment advice or historical price analysis
